Links every source patient record to a golden patient (or REVIEW/UNMATCHED). Per identity_rules_v1.1.md. Never merges on doubt.
One GP clinic; clinic_key is a warehouse key and clinic_id is the source ID.
One calendar day from 2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31; shared date dimension.

One medicine item, including source code, pack details, daily dose and drug class.

Nine shared prototype parameters from task card v3 D1; rule owner A. Cast values explicitly.
UC1: one row per golden patient with a care gap or pending high-result review; business_rules_v1.2. Dates and VALID/LINKED eligibility inherited from CURATED.
UC2: PDC medication adherence per golden patient and drug class. Parameters from reporting.rule_parameter.
UC3: parameterised HbA1c trend over (as_of_date - trend_window_months, as_of_date]; best PDC across UC2 drug classes; no PDC gives a false adherence flag. business_rules_v1.2.
UC4: care-path breaks - unreturned VALID results and multi-pharmacy overlaps. Parameters from reporting.rule_parameter.
